Name: Eemie's Classy New Interior for Custom Furniture
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Eemie's furniture from A Classy New Interior, now for Custom Furniture
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

For the custom furniture fanatic, here is the furniture from Eemie's Classy New Interior, now in the CF format!

This mod requires [Custom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254) to work, which in turn requires [PyTK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)﻿.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install PyTK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)﻿.

3.  [Install Custom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254)﻿.

4.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CF] Eemie's Classy New Furniture' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

5.  Play the game, you're done!
Note
Currently Custom Furniture does not support items that change size when rotating (i.e. tables that are not square).  Two of the small coffee tables are not coded properly because of this.  Support for odd shaped items may be included in a future CF update.

Credit for the original [mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/854)﻿ goes to [eemiestardew](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615), who kindly gave permission for this conversion.
Credit for the conversion goes to amariel34#6071 on the SDV discord, who gave permission for this to be hosted on Nexus.

Source code found [here](https://github.com/minervamaga?tab=repositories)﻿.  Feel free to [submit a pull request](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-a-pull-request)﻿ with improvements or translations.  You can also [report issues or request features using the Issues tab](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-an-issue)﻿!
